title: God is so Mighty
textBlocks:
What a Mighty God we serve
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story you will hear how MIGHTY God is
That there is nothing He can not do

God parts the Jordan river - not once - twice! Just in this story
(God had always stopped it flowing for Joshua and the 2 million people who crossed it into the Promised Land)
Then God sends a horse and chariot made of fire 
And then takes Elijah to heaven in a WHIRLWIND!
God controls the weather, the rain, the wind, the animals EVERYTHING
